# Priscilla Grant

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020)</sub>
- **Origin:** The Island  <sub>[v3 c4 P31](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0031)</sub>
- **Role:** College student at Redmond  <sub>[v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020), [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla is described as golden and fair. On special occasions, she wears silk attire.

_Sources: [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Priscilla possesses a sensible nature and a clear mind, holding serious views of life alongside her friend Anne. She enjoys a good laugh at Philippa Gordon's playful nonsense and demonstrates an amused, thoughtful perspective on social dynamics and comradeship.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P45](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0045), [v3 c4 P70](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0070), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003)_

- Sensible  <sub>[v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003)</sub>

## Abilities

- Academic study  <sub>[v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000)</sub>

## Goals

- Pursue higher education at Redmond College  <sub>[v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020), [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000)</sub>

## History

Priscilla drove to Green Gables in silk attire accompanied by her aunt, Mrs. Charlotte E. Morgan, and Mrs. Pendexter to visit Anne Shirley. Later, she attended Redmond College in Kingsport alongside Anne. On her first morning there, she and Anne met Philippa Gordon in Old St. John's Cemetery, where they quickly hit off a lasting friendship. Through Philippa's social circle, Priscilla became fully integrated into the college's social and academic life, participating in Freshman class victories and gatherings.

_Sources: [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 c20 P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024), [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020), [v3 c4 P31](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0031), [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)_
